faq.question: What does JSON escaping do?
faq.answer: JSON escaping adds backslash characters before special characters like quotes, newlines, and tabs so they can be safely included in a JSON string.

faq.question: What does JSON unescaping do?
faq.answer: JSON unescaping removes the backslash escape characters, converting escaped sequences back to their original characters.

faq.question: When should I escape JSON?
faq.answer: Escape JSON when embedding a JSON string inside another JSON string, or when including JSON in code, logs, or configuration files.

faq.question: When should I unescape JSON?
faq.answer: Unescape JSON when you have an escaped JSON string (from logs, API responses, or code) and need to read the actual JSON content.

faq.question: What special characters are escaped?
faq.answer: Common escaped characters include: quotes (\"), backslashes (\\), newlines (\n), tabs (\t), carriage returns (\r), and unicode characters (\uXXXX).

article.title: How to Escape & Unescape JSON Strings Online
article.content:
What is JSON Escaping?

JSON escaping adds backslash characters before special characters so they can be safely included in JSON strings. This is essential when embedding one JSON string inside another.

Common Escaped Characters

  • \" — Double quote
  • \\ — Backslash
  • \n — Newline
  • \t — Tab
  • \r — Carriage return
  • \uXXXX — Unicode character

When to Escape

  • Nesting JSON: Embedding a JSON string inside another JSON
  • Code Generation: Including JSON in JavaScript strings
  • Logs: Writing JSON to log files
  • Configuration: Including JSON in config files

When to Unescape

  • Reading Logs: Parsing escaped JSON from log files
  • API Responses: Handling escaped strings from APIs
  • Debugging: Viewing escaped JSON content

How to Use

  1. Paste your escaped or unescaped string
  2. Click Escape to add escape characters
  3. Or click Unescape to remove them
  4. Copy the result

article.title: 如何在线转义和反转义 JSON 字符串
article.content:
什么是 JSON 转义？

JSON 转义在特殊字符前添加反斜杠，使其可以安全地包含在 JSON 字符串中。当在另一个 JSON 字符串中嵌入 JSON 字符串时，这是必不可少的。

常见转义字符

  • \" — 双引号
  • \\ — 反斜杠
  • \n — 换行符
  • \t — 制表符
  • \r — 回车符
  • \uXXXX — Unicode 字符

何时转义

  • 嵌套 JSON：在另一个 JSON 中嵌入 JSON 字符串
  • 代码生成：在 JavaScript 字符串中包含 JSON
  • 日志：将 JSON 写入日志文件
  • 配置：在配置文件中包含 JSON

何时反转义

  • 读取日志：解析日志文件中的转义 JSON
  • API 响应：处理来自 API 的转义字符串
  • 调试：查看转义的 JSON 内容

如何使用

  1. 粘贴 你的转义或未转义字符串
  2. 点击转义 添加转义字符
  3. 或点击反转义 移除它们
  4. 复制 结果
